description: Per-project Vercel environment-variable manifest. Consumed by scripts/vercel/sync-env.mjs and validated by scripts/vercel/validate.mjs. Variables were derived from each service's Zod AppConfig schema (apps/<service>/src/app/config/app.config.ts), Prisma datasource blocks, Mongoose connection strings, Redis clients, provider adapters, and the frontend's process.env usage.

conventions.shared: Entries under `shared` are declared once and fanned out to the projects listed in their `appliesTo` array. Nothing is sent to a project that is not listed.
conventions.secret: `secret: true` variables are uploaded with Vercel's `sensitive` type so their values cannot be read back through the API or dashboard.
conventions.derived: Entries under `derived` are NOT read from .env.vercel. They are computed from live Vercel deployment URLs by scripts/vercel/resolve-service-urls.mjs and synced with `--sync`.
conventions.neverPublic: OLLAMA_API_KEY and every other secret must never appear as a NEXT_PUBLIC_* variable. validate.mjs fails the run if a secret is declared with a NEXT_PUBLIC_ prefix.

shared.name: JWT_SECRET
shared.description: Shared HS256 JWT signing secret. Minimum 32 characters. Every service verifies access tokens with this value, so it must be byte-identical across all projects.

shared.name: ENCRYPTION_KEY
shared.description: AES-256-GCM key as 64 hex characters. Encrypts connector API keys, workspace OAuth tokens, research provider credentials, and agent secrets. Rotating it makes existing ciphertext unreadable.

shared.name: INTER_SERVICE_AUTH_TOKEN
shared.description: Shared bearer for `Authorization: Service <token>` calls into guarded /api/v1/internal/* endpoints. Minimum 32 characters. Must match across every project that appears here.

shared.name: REDIS_URL
shared.description: Redis connection string (rediss:// recommended). Use a serverless-friendly provider such as Upstash — a per-invocation TCP pool against a single-node Redis will exhaust connections.

shared.name: RABBITMQ_URL
shared.description: AMQP connection string for the claw.events topic exchange (e.g. CloudAMQP). Publishing works from a serverless function; durable consumption does not — see the runtimeCaveats on audit and server-logs in projects.json.

shared.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
shared.description: Base URL of the EXTERNAL Ollama-compatible API (for example https://ollama.com or a self-hosted gateway). ClawAI on Vercel never runs a local Ollama runtime.

shared.name: OLLAMA_API_KEY
shared.description: Bearer credential for the external Ollama-compatible API. NEVER expose this through a NEXT_PUBLIC_* variable and never send it to the frontend project.

shared.name: CORS_ORIGINS
shared.description: Comma-separated list of allowed browser origins. On Vercel this is the frontend production URL plus any custom domain. Preview deployments need the preview frontend origin.

shared.name: NODE_ENV
shared.description: Node environment. Vercel sets this automatically; declare it only to override.

derived.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
derived.description: Public base URL the browser calls. Set to the frontend's own origin so the vercel.json rewrites proxy /api/v1/* through to each backend project.

derived.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL
derived.description: Public origin of the ClawAI web app. agent-service uses it to build device-pairing links.

auth.name: AUTH_DATABASE_URL
auth.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_auth database (runtime queries).

auth.name: ADMIN_EMAIL
auth.description: Bootstrap admin email, seeded on first boot only.

auth.name: ADMIN_USERNAME
auth.description: Bootstrap admin username, seeded on first boot only.

auth.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
auth.description: Bootstrap admin password (argon2-hashed at seed time). Rotate immediately after the first login.

auth.name: SEED_RECONCILE_PERMISSIONS
auth.description: 'true' hard-reconciles system-role permissions on boot (adds AND removes). Default 'false' is add-only.

chat.name: CHAT_DATABASE_URL
chat.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_chat database.

chat.name: OLLAMA_GENERATE_TIMEOUT_MS
chat.description: Upper bound on a single external-Ollama generation call. Must stay below the Vercel function maxDuration or the request is cut off first.

chat.name: OLLAMA_TOOL_LOOP_MAX_ITERATIONS
chat.description: Agentic tool-loop iteration cap. Default 50; lower it on Vercel so the loop fits inside maxDuration.

chat.name: OLLAMA_TOOL_LOOP_TOTAL_TIMEOUT_MS
chat.description: Wall-clock cap for the whole agentic tool loop.

chat.name: ENABLE_ANTHROPIC_NATIVE_PDF
chat.description: Forward PDFs to Anthropic as a native document part instead of extracted text. Default false.

chat.name: ENABLE_GEMINI_FILES_API
chat.description: Upload large attachments through Gemini's Files API. Default false.

chat.name: ALLOW_LOCAL_ONLY_ATTACHMENTS_WITHOUT_VISION
chat.description: Allow image attachments in LOCAL_ONLY / PRIVACY_FIRST modes with no local vision model. Default false.

chat.name: ROUTING_THREAD_CONTEXT_INJECTION_ENABLED
chat.description: Semantic-router thread-context injection flag. Default true.

chat.name: ROUTING_FOLLOW_UP_DETECTION_ENABLED
chat.description: Semantic-router follow-up detection flag. Default true.

connector.name: CONNECTOR_DATABASE_URL
connector.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_connectors database.

routing.name: ROUTING_DATABASE_URL
routing.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_routing database.

routing.name: OLLAMA_ROUTER_MODEL
routing.description: Model the AUTO router asks for a classification. Must exist on the external Ollama endpoint.

routing.name: OLLAMA_ROUTER_TIMEOUT_MS
routing.description: Router call timeout before falling back to the heuristic classifier. Default 5000.

routing.name: OLLAMA_ROUTER_WARMUP_ENABLED
routing.description: Set to 'false' on Vercel. The warmup interval timer cannot persist between serverless invocations.

memory.name: MEMORY_DATABASE_URL
memory.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_memory database. Requires the pgvector extension.

memory.name: MEMORY_EXTRACTION_MODEL
memory.description: Model used to extract FACT/PREFERENCE/INSTRUCTION/SUMMARY memories. Default 'AUTO'.

memory.name: MEMORY_SENSITIVITY_MODEL
memory.description: Model for ambiguous-case sensitivity classification. Default gemma3:4b.

memory.name: EMBEDDING_MODEL
memory.description: Embedding model for semantic memory search. Default nomic-embed-text.

memory.name: EMBEDDING_DIMENSIONS
memory.description: Embedding vector width. Must match the pgvector column dimension. Default 768.

file.name: FILES_DATABASE_URL
file.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_files database.

file.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
file.description: Vercel Blob (or S3-compatible) read/write token. Required because the Vercel filesystem is ephemeral — uploads must land in object storage, not FILE_STORAGE_PATH.

file.name: FILE_STORAGE_PATH
file.description: Scratch directory for in-flight uploads. MUST be under /tmp on Vercel; nothing written here survives the invocation.

file.name: CLAMAV_ENABLED
file.description: Set to 'false' on Vercel unless CLAMAV_HOST points at an externally reachable ClamAV TCP endpoint. There is no ClamAV sidecar.

file.name: CLAMAV_HOST
file.description: Hostname of an external ClamAV daemon. Only meaningful when CLAMAV_ENABLED is true.

file.name: OCR_ENABLED
file.description: Set to 'false' on Vercel — the tesseract worker pool needs native binaries and a persistent process.

file.name: ZIP_TEMP_EXTRACTION_PATH
file.description: ZIP extraction sandbox. MUST be under /tmp on Vercel.

file.name: FILE_RETENTION_DAYS
file.description: Days before an uploaded file is eligible for retention deletion. 0 disables retention.

audit.name: AUDIT_MONGODB_URL
audit.description: MongoDB connection string for the audit database (Atlas recommended).

client-logs.name: CLIENT_LOGS_MONGODB_URL
client-logs.description: MongoDB connection string for the client-logs database. TTL index created by scripts/vercel/migrate.mjs.

server-logs.name: SERVER_LOGS_MONGODB_URL
server-logs.description: MongoDB connection string for the server-logs database. TTL index created by scripts/vercel/migrate.mjs.

image.name: IMAGE_DATABASE_URL
image.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_images database.

image.name: CLAW_IMAGE_PROGRESS_PREVIEW_ENABLED
image.description: Emit intermediate image previews over the progress channel. Default false.

file-generation.name: FILE_GENERATION_DATABASE_URL
file-generation.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_file_generations database.

workspace.name: WORKSPACE_DATABASE_URL
workspace.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_workspace database.

workspace.name: WORKSPACE_SCHEDULER_ENABLED
workspace.description: Set to 'false' on Vercel. The in-process sync ticker cannot run between serverless invocations; scheduled background sync is a known gap until trigger endpoints exist.

workspace.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
workspace.description: GitHub OAuth app client id for workspace connectors.

workspace.name: GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
workspace.description: HMAC secret for verifying inbound GitHub webhook deliveries.

workspace.name: GITLAB_WEBHOOK_SECRET
workspace.description: Secret token for verifying inbound GitLab webhook deliveries.

workspace.name: BITBUCKET_WEBHOOK_SECRET
workspace.description: Secret for verifying inbound Bitbucket webhook deliveries.

workspace.name: JIRA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
workspace.description: Secret for verifying inbound Jira webhook deliveries.

workspace.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
workspace.description: Google OAuth client id (Drive, Gmail connectors).

workspace.name: FIGMA_WEBHOOK_SECRET
workspace.description: Secret for verifying inbound Figma webhook deliveries.

workspace.name: ADMIN_IP_ALLOWLIST
workspace.description: Comma-separated CIDR allowlist for workspace admin endpoints. Empty disables the check.

agent.name: AGENT_DATABASE_URL
agent.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_agent database.

agent.name: AGENT_REFRESH_TTL_DAYS
agent.description: Desktop-agent refresh-token lifetime in days. Default 30.

research.name: RESEARCH_DATABASE_URL
research.description: Pooled PostgreSQL connection string for the claw_research database.

research.name: SEARXNG_BASE_URL
research.description: Base URL of an externally hosted SearXNG instance. There is no local SearXNG on Vercel.

research.name: RESEARCH_DOMAIN_ALLOWLIST
research.description: Comma-separated domains research fetch/scrape is allowed to reach.

research.name: RESEARCH_DOMAIN_BLOCKLIST
research.description: Comma-separated domains research fetch/scrape must never reach.

frontend.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_NAME
frontend.description: Display name shown in the UI shell. Default 'ClawAI'.

frontend.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_ROUTING_DEBUG_CONTEXT_INSPECTOR_ENABLED
frontend.description: Shows the router context inspector panel. Preview only — never enable in production.
